name: Apparent-energy meter
summary: Integrating meter that totalises apparent energy in kVAh, used where tariffs charge on kVA rather than kW.
description: An apparent-energy meter totalises volt-amperes over time. Some network tariffs and demand charges are based on kVA, so this register appears on supply-point single-line diagrams beside the kWh and kvarh registers of the revenue meter.

Apparent energy can be calculated in more than one way when harmonics or unbalance are present, for example arithmetically from each phase or vectorially from total watts and vars. The symbol does not say which method is used, and two meters with different methods can disagree.
readingNotes: Check which calculation method the meter uses.
Read with the kWh and kvarh registers at the same point.
distinction: A kVAh meter totalises apparent energy; a kWh meter totalises only the active part.
